verdict.rationale: Smithery documents its own REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, plus API keys and scoped service tokens that let agents list and call tools. That covers programmatic use of the core connect/call workflow. The evidence does not show a full endpoint reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Publishing is described as a UI flow. missing for 10: published API reference/OpenAPI spec, evidence of API coverage beyond connections and tool calls (e.g. publishing/registry management), independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Smithery gives you a simple REST interface for connecting to MCP servers.
Service tokens let you safely expose Smithery to browsers, mobile apps, and AI agents without leaking your API key.
This token can list and call tools on connections in `my-app` where `metadata.userId` is `user-123` — nothing else.
Resources within a namespace can be managed by anyone with the appropriate API key scoped to that namespace
